drafts_today.topic: One week to Trail Bay: Black Friday, Fri Nov 27 + Sun Nov 29
drafts_today.text:
One week from today, skip the Black Friday crowds and come see me at Trail Bay.

Fri Nov 27, 11 to 4
Sun Nov 29

Try the RIMAN textures, ask me about skin after 40, and guess the candies in the tub to win a Multi Stick Balm, a facial, or both.

Who's coming?
drafts_today.picture_tip: Your Trail Bay poster (both dates) on the counter beside the candy tub and a Multi Stick Balm, window daylight.
drafts_today.video_tip: 6-8s clip: shake the candy tub at the camera, set it down next to the Multi Stick Balm. On-screen text: 'One week! Trail Bay Nov 27 + 29'.

drafts_today.topic: Chapped lips after 40: day and night
drafts_today.text:
Chapped lips after 40? It's winter plus dry heat, not one bad balm.

What works for me:
1. Stop licking them
2. Day: ICD Multi Stick Balm whenever they feel tight
3. Night: a generous layer of Glow Up Lip Oil as a lip sleeping mask

Save this for tonight.
drafts_today.picture_tip: Close-up of the Multi Stick Balm and Glow Up Lip Oil on your nightstand next to a book and a lamp, warm evening light.
drafts_today.video_tip: 8-10s: swipe the Multi Stick Balm on in daylight, cut to the nightstand lamp and a generous layer of Glow Up Lip Oil. Text: 'Day / Night'.

drafts_today.topic: Weekend glow habit: Beauty Collagen with morning coffee
drafts_today.text:
Turning 40 didn't take your glow. Skipping the basics did.

My 3 small habits:
1. Water before coffee
2. Sunscreen, even on grey Coast days
3. One RIMAN Beauty Collagen ampoule, alone or in 6 oz of water (contains fish and wheat)

What's your one non-negotiable?
drafts_today.picture_tip: Kitchen counter at morning: a Beauty Collagen ampoule, a glass of water, your coffee mug and the Moisture Layer Sunscreen, soft window light.
drafts_today.video_tip: 6-8s: pour the ampoule into a glass of water, stir once, sip, then reach for the coffee. Text: '3 tiny habits after 40'.
